policy.admission: Only the three exact directed station pairs in all six complete PostAuto-121 patterns on 4/6 September 2026. Both directions follow the full documented western diversion; original platforms are attached within 15 m to reviewed road nodes, retaining distinct station arrivals. Require exact source-node joins, forward one-way/roundabout travel, ordinary bus access and no touching returned restrictions. No current OSM bus-121 relation was returned; project documents identify the corridor, not a surveyed lane path. The specific 2.0/2.5 km ceilings do not relax general detour guards. Preserve all prior failures and original calls/times. No map geometry extracted from project documents.
